name: Cast Swap
summary: Swap anyone in a video for yourself or any character: it scans the clip, maps your images to the people you pick, and writes one timestamped video-to-video prompt that keeps every move, cut and second.
use_when: The user wants to put themselves or a character into a movie scene, music video or TikTok, swap or recast an actor or singer, replace a person in a video with a reference image, restyle a clip while swapping its cast (anime, 3D animated, a show's own style), or fix a character swap that came out wrong.
produces: A scan of the uploaded clip (exact duration, cuts, every person, a timestamped timeline), then one copy-ready video-to-video prompt that states the duration, maps each reference image to the person it replaces, carries whole-second timestamps from the real cuts, and comes with attach, settings, @-tag and tool-fit notes. Long clips are split into parts that add up exactly.
